a.lede: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.

b.lede: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades.
